notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/604780/aMAZE/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025983/4c26ab63083b69cca5b95ebee8ab89c22de5da39.png[/img][/url]
[quote][i][b]Hello dear players! Today we have prepared for you  global update for our game - aMAZE ![/b][/i][/quote]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/604780/aMAZE/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yx1ubsdrNVg

[quote][i][b]List of changes added to the game aMAZE:
[/b][/i][/quote]

-  Added support for XBOX One and XBOX 360 gamepads  
-  Changed level design throughout the game.
-  Added animated mouse pointer
-  Mazes have been visually improved at all levels
-  Visually improved destination at all levels  
-  Added player pointer in levels 
-  Improved ball movement (player)
-  Visually improved buttons throughout the game
-  Added social media buttons to the main menu
-  Added a button to turn on / off music at all levels
-  Added sound for all buttons in the game
-  Added exit button to the main menu from the menu of the selection of levels

[quote][i][b]Thank you for your support us!
We hope you enjoy it, have a nice day!)
[/b][/i][/quote]

notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/628750/aMAZE_2/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025983/f030283575c6df385a2311d105695ac644939e1a.png[/img][/url]
[quote][i][b]Hello dear players! Today we have prepared for you  global update for our game - aMAZE 2 ![/b][/i][/quote]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/628750/aMAZE_2/

[quote][i][b]List of changes added to the game aMAZE 2:
[/b][/i][/quote]

1.  Added support for XBOX One and XBOX 360 gamepads  
2.  Changed level design throughout the game.
3.  Added animated mouse pointer
4.  Mazes have been visually improved at all levels
5.  Visually improved destination at all levels  
6.  Added player pointer in levels 
7.  Improved ball movement (player)
8.  Visually improved buttons throughout the game
9.  Added social media buttons to the main menu
10. Added a button to turn on / off music at all levels
11. Added sound for all buttons in the game
12. Added exit button to the main menu from the menu of the selection of levels

[quote][i][b]Thank you for your support us! Enjoy
We hope you enjoy it, have a nice day!)
[/b][/i][/quote]
